changes.summary: Added the directly installable MiaAI-Lab GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 DFlash2 two-Spark Candidate.
changes.details: Pins runtime source 79f10b91, the resolved ARM64 GHCR digest, MiaAI-Lab's exact 25a44fdb EXL3/TR3 target pin and the complete dc77ff1c DFlash2 inventory, separate ShapleyMCG and CC BY-NC-ND operator acceptance, Controller-native mp deployment without SSH, and a conservative 126 GB per-node unified-memory admission envelope derived from MiaAI-Lab's measured 105.9 GiB post-init requirement and 18.67 GiB KV pool. Physical Vonk acceptance remains pending.
